purpose: KI-Konzeptmockups, keine Ingame-Aufnahmen der Umsetzung. Bestehendes Spielbild als Kompositionsreferenz, SOURA0 und QRUNE2 als Zeichenreferenzen. Generierte Glyphen sind stilistische Annäherungen, keine pixelidentische Wiederverwendung der Spielassets.

prompts.name: 01-schild-geschlossen
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: in-game visual design mockup for the existing Doom/UZDoom map TNT04CN, boss The Source. Edit image 1 (the actual arena close-up screenshot). Image 2 is the actual existing SOURA0 demon sigil sprite, a mandatory identity/style reference: preserve its horned skull motif, occult geometry, and angular runic alphabet. Image 3 is an existing rune reference from this game's texture family. Reuse that visual language, no new alphabet or generic fantasy writing.
Maintain the exact screenshot camera and framing, perspective, rock wall geometry, torches, existing little distant enemies, original HUD and counters unchanged. Preserve the crunchy rock textures and retro game renderer look. No photorealistic new environment, no new architecture, no extra characters, no weapon, no diagram or added text. This is a believable screenshot paintover, not a cinematic illustration.
Redesign only the central Source beam, spiral, circular demon sigil and shield. Keep their original placement: vertical beam rises beyond top and bottom image, and round demon sigil hangs in upper middle slightly behind it. Narrow the opaque white beam to roughly a third of original width, restrained golden orange halo with clear dark gaps between thin spiral turns. Make the demon sigil clearly legible behind it, with dark internal negative space, fine amber orange skull lines, two concentric rings of the EXISTING angular rune family. Preserve source identity instead of turning it into an eye, creature or mechanical device. Carefully controlled bloom, brightest small areas only. Keep surroundings readable with local warm illumination.
Single landscape 16:9 image. No collage.
STATE 1 — SHIELD CLOSED: A calm, intact closed circular runic seal. Two continuous thin amber rings, all runes orderly and lit. A faint transparent cylindrical shielding membrane around the beam, described mainly by sparse runic marks and soft contour edges, never a solid glowing curtain. A small localized circular ripple from an impact on the lower-right part of the shield clearly signals protection. The core behind the skull sigil stays dark, contained and inaccessible. Spiral motion appears regular. The design should feel ancient, infernal and powerful while being far less overexposed than the original.

prompts.name: 02-schadensfenster
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create mockup 2 of the SAME TNT04CN Source boss, using image 1 as the edit target (approved direction of closed shield), image 2 as the mandatory original horned demon skull sigil identity. Match image 1 camera, framing, all environment geometry, rock textures, torches, tiny background enemies, original HUD pixel icons and numbers exactly. Single 16:9 game screenshot paintover with the same retro UZDoom render style, no added labels.
CHANGE ONLY THE BOSS EFFECT STATE to SHIELD OPEN / VULNERABLE: completely remove the large transparent cylinder shield, its long vertical edges and its floating side runes. The thin circular rune band around the skull sigil splits into six separated arcs, each displaced slightly outwards leaving very obvious dark gaps, shedding a few amber angular glyph fragments. Keep the central horned skull's fine linework intact and recognizable, but reveal a compact intensely glowing amber-white energy heart inside its forehead/central face, framed by dark negative space and still readable skull horns. The vertical Source beam remains in the same x position and retains its long helical spiral, but becomes translucent and markedly dimmer across the face of the boss so it does not conceal the exposed energy heart. The upper and lower beam portions stay golden with controlled bloom. A short fading thread of golden energy rises diagonally from the right-side background guardian position into one broken rune arc, communicating that a guardian death ruptured the shield; do not invent a large foreground monster. Fine sparks at the six arc breaks, a very few drifting rune fragments, otherwise clear space. The exposed compact heart, absent shield membrane and separated runic arcs must give a dramatically different and clearly vulnerable silhouette compared to the closed state. Preserve the same existing angular rune language. No eye, no new monster design, no blue sci-fi elements, no opaque explosion or smoke curtain, no architecture change.

prompts.name: 03-eskalation-kometensalve
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: third state mockup of the TNT04CN final boss The Source in retro Doom/UZDoom. Image 1 is the exact target closed-shield mockup to edit, image 2 the mandatory original demon skull sigil design. Match the same camera, 16:9 framing, rock geometry, all torches and small distant characters, crisp retro textures and original HUD unchanged. No new environment, no added text, no collage.
Change only the boss effect into LATE FIGHT / COMET ATTACK CHARGING. Preserve its recognizable horned demon skull magic circle at the same upper-central position, narrow continuous vertical golden beam and surrounding thin helical energy spiral. Keep the sigil skull readable with dark spaces and fine amber lines. The cylindrical transparent shield remains PRESENT: faint intact vertical contours and sparse angular runes on both sides show it is CLOSED. Its circular runic band is also still closed, distinguishing this from an open damage window.
Show visual damage WITHIN the sigil: several fine jagged hot cracks across its internal geometry, a few extinguished glyphs, thin amber energy escaping from cracks, slightly uneven spiral spacing. Do not break the closed outer ring or remove the shield. Most of the scene stays dark and legible.
The COMET ATTACK SIGNAL is the hero feature: exactly three compact molten-orange rocky orbs charging above the sigil along its upper circumference, at upper-left, top-center slightly to the right of the central beam, and upper-right. Each is wrapped in a small partial ring using the same existing angular rune family. Show a readable sequential charge: first orb fully glowing with a tight small flame crown, second ember-orange, third a dark fragment just beginning to ignite. Their brief fine curved energy feeds visibly originate from the sigil. Keep them relatively small: each under 1/8 the sigil diameter. No fired trails crossing the whole arena, no giant flames, no new enemy. Copper-red accents mark unstable energy, gold remains boss identity. Restrained dynamic light highlights nearby rock details, no global red filter. This should clearly convey a damaged but shielded Source preparing its next volley, preserving an implementable game-effects aesthetic.
